Step 3: Verify each card shows last modified date

description: Clicking a project card opens the editor

Step 2: Click on a project card
Step 3: Verify navigation to /projects/[id] editor page
Step 4: Verify editor UI loads with the project data

Step 2: Click three-dot context menu on a project card

description: User can delete (archive) a project
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /projects
Step 2: Click three-dot context menu on a project
Step 3: Click 'Delete' option
Step 4: Confirm deletion in dialog
Step 5: Verify project is removed from the list

description: User can rename project inline from the editor top bar
steps: Step 1: Open a project in the editor
Step 2: Click on the project name in the top bar
Step 3: Edit the name
Step 4: Press Enter or click away
Step 5: Verify name is updated
Step 6: Navigate back to /projects and verify new name shows

description: User can toggle project shareable link on/off in settings

Step 2: Open settings drawer
Step 3: Find public link toggle (default off)
Step 4: Toggle it on
Step 5: Verify shareable URL is displayed
Step 6: Toggle it off
Step 7: Verify link is no longer active

Step 5: Verify no editor UI is shown

Step 2: Navigate to /view/[project-id] without auth
Step 3: Verify access is denied or 404 page shown

Step 2: Log out, log in as User B
Step 3: Navigate to /projects
Step 4: Verify User A's project is not visible

description: Editor page shows filmstrip sidebar, main canvas, and top bar

Step 2: Verify filmstrip sidebar is on the left (~200px wide)
Step 3: Verify main canvas occupies center area
Step 4: Verify top bar is present with project name, zoom, undo/redo, settings, present, export buttons

description: Editor top bar has zoom controls (fit to screen, percentage slider)

Step 2: Verify zoom controls are present

Step 4: Verify slide fits within the canvas area
Step 5: Adjust zoom slider
Step 6: Verify slide scales accordingly

description: Editor top bar has undo/redo buttons

Step 2: Verify undo button is present (disabled when no history)
Step 3: Verify redo button is present (disabled when no redo available)

description: Settings drawer opens from gear icon in top bar

Step 2: Click gear/settings icon in top bar
Step 3: Verify settings drawer slides in from the right
Step 4: Verify it contains font selectors, gap slider, border radius slider, aspect ratio picker, public link toggle

description: Image tray is visible and collapsible at bottom of editor

Step 3: Click collapse toggle
Step 4: Verify tray collapses
Step 5: Click toggle again
Step 6: Verify tray expands

description: New project starts with one blank title slide

description: User can add a title slide

Step 4: Verify new title slide is added
Step 5: Verify it renders with hero image area and text overlay

description: User can add a text-only slide

Step 3: Select 'Text-only slide' from dropdown
Step 4: Verify new text-only slide appears with heading and body fields

description: User can delete a slide

description: User can duplicate a slide

Step 4: Select 3:4, verify canvas ratio

description: User can navigate between slides with Up/Down arrow keys

description: User can drag image files from desktop onto slide canvas

Step 2: Drag an image file from the desktop/file explorer onto the canvas

description: User can drag multiple images from desktop at once

Step 2: Select 3 image files on desktop
Step 3: Drag all 3 onto the slide canvas
Step 4: Drop them
Step 5: Verify all 3 images are uploaded

Step 7: Verify all 3 appear in the image tray

description: Upload button opens file picker and supports multiple selection

Step 2: Click upload button (in image tray or toolbar)
Step 3: Verify file picker opens
Step 4: Select multiple images
Step 5: Confirm selection
Step 6: Verify all images are uploaded and added to tray

description: Supported image formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
steps: Step 1: Upload a JPEG image, verify success
Step 2: Upload a PNG image, verify success
Step 3: Upload a WebP image, verify success

description: Image upload generates thumbnail and extracts metadata
steps: Step 1: Upload an image to the project
Step 2: Verify original is stored in Supabase Storage
Step 3: Verify thumbnail is generated and stored
Step 4: Verify image record has width, height, aspect_ratio, file_size, mime_type

description: Optimistic UI: image appears immediately with loading spinner during upload

Step 2: Verify image placeholder/preview appears immediately
Step 3: Verify loading spinner overlay is shown
Step 4: Wait for upload to complete
Step 5: Verify spinner disappears and final image is rendered

description: Image tray shows all images uploaded to the project
steps: Step 1: Upload 5 images to a project across different slides
Step 2: Verify image tray shows all 5 images
Step 3: Verify horizontal scroll works when tray overflows

description: Images can be uploaded directly to the tray without placing on a slide
steps: Step 1: Open editor
Step 2: Click upload button in image tray
Step 3: Select images
Step 4: Verify images appear in tray but not on any slide

description: User can drag image from tray onto a slide
steps: Step 1: Ensure image tray has images
Step 2: Drag an image from the tray onto the current slide canvas
Step 3: Verify image is added to the slide
Step 4: Verify layout recalculates

description: Deleting image from tray removes it from all slides with confirmation

Step 2: Open image tray
Step 3: Right-click or context menu on the image in tray
Step 4: Click delete
Step 5: Verify confirmation dialog appears
Step 6: Confirm deletion
Step 7: Verify image is removed from tray
Step 8: Verify image is removed from both slides
Step 9: Verify both slides re-layout

description: Image tray shows badge on images currently used on a slide

Step 2: Check image tray
Step 3: Verify the used image shows a usage badge/indicator
Step 4: Remove image from slide
Step 5: Verify badge is removed from tray thumbnail

description: Auto-layout: 1 photo fills entire photo region (full bleed)

Step 2: Add 1 image
Step 3: Verify image fills the entire photo region of the slide

steps: Step 1: Add 2 portrait images to a slide
Step 2: Verify layout shows them side by side
Step 3: Verify each takes approximately 50% width

steps: Step 1: Add 2 landscape images to a slide
Step 2: Verify layout shows them stacked vertically

description: Auto-layout: 5 photos - two top + three bottom

description: Auto-layout: 5 photos - all variants accessible

Step 3: Cycle through all 4 variants
Step 4: Verify each layout renders correctly

description: Auto-layout: 6 photos - 2x3 grid
